run.change_description:
fix(redis2): remove orphaned directory index members on listing

ListDirectoryEntries skipped index members whose value key was gone and
left them in the ZSET, so the per-directory child index grew without
bound under any TTL workload. Mirror the ZRem the logical-expiry branch
already performs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(redis2): keep the index member when a concurrent insert recreates the value

The orphan cleanup removed the member unconditionally, so an InsertEntry
landing between FindEntry and the ZRem left a live value with no index
member, invisible to listings until another InsertEntry on that path.
UpdateEntry does not re-add it, so the loss persisted.

Restore the member when the value is present again after the removal.
The value key and the directory index key hash to different slots, so a
Lua script or MULTI over both is not available to the cluster store.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

summary.intent: Stop the redis2 per-directory child index (the `<dir>\x00` ZSET) from growing without bound: ListDirectoryEntries now removes an index member once its value key is confirmed gone, and restores it if a concurrent InsertEntry recreates the value during the repair window.
summary.issue_fit: No linked issue; alignment judged against the caller-supplied pull-request description (spec-pr10735) and its two commits, which the diff satisfies.
summary.coverage: Both changed files read in full at head and merge-base. go vet and go test reproduced clean for weed/filer/redis2 offline (no live Redis, so the new tests SKIP by design; traced by hand against the code instead). The compensating-restore concurrency premise was independently verified by a fresh-context worker and holds.

observations.fact: removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember's restore call carries no isSuperLargeDirectory guard; InsertEntry skips ZAddNX for a super-large directory (universal_redis_store.go:62-65) so its ZSET is normally never populated, but a directory reconfigured to super-large after already holding index members would still have a stray member re-added by the repair path if a value reappears during the ZRem→EXISTS window — a narrow edge case reintroducing exactly the per-entry bookkeeping the super-large-directory setting exists to avoid.

requirements.evidence: ListDirectoryEntries calls removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember on FindEntry's ErrNotFound (universal_redis_store.go:207-208), which ZRems the stale member (line 238).

requirements.source: spec-pr10735/body/"Restore the member when the value is present again after the removal."
requirements.evidence: removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember re-checks EXISTS and ZAddNX-restores the member when the value is present or the recheck itself errors (universal_redis_store.go:245-250); exercised by TestRemoveOrphanedDirectoryListMemberKeepsRecreatedEntry and by the verified concurrency premise (record.verification, premise-1, ruling: holds).

requirements.source: spec-pr10735/body/"the new ZREM reuses that variable instead of rebuilding the key"
requirements.evidence: removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember receives the already-prefixed dirListKey local (line 178) from its caller and never rebuilds it; TestListDirectoryEntriesRemovesOrphanedIndexMembers runs both keyPrefix="" and keyPrefix="sw:" subtests.

requirements.source: spec-pr10735/body/"The branch guard is err == filer_pb.ErrNotFound — identity, not errors.Is"
requirements.evidence: Line 207's `if err == filer_pb.ErrNotFound` is an unchanged identity comparison; FindEntry (lines 100-106) returns that exact sentinel only for redis.Nil and wraps every other failure with fmt.Errorf, so a transient error still breaks the loop instead of invoking the new cleanup.

requirements.source: spec-pr10735/body/"Cleanup failures still do not fail the listing"
requirements.evidence: removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember returns void; its internal ZRem/EXISTS errors never propagate, and ListDirectoryEntries still sets err = nil and continues after calling it (line 209).
universal_redis_store_test.go:16-17 skips via `os.Getenv("RUN_REDIS_TESTS") != "1"`, matching tarantool_store_test.go's identical gate (verified by direct read).

requirements.source: spec-pr10735/body/"go build ./weed/..., go vet ./weed/filer/redis2/, gofmt all clean, and go test ./weed/filer/redis2/... -race passes against a live Redis."
requirements.evidence: Reproduced clean offline for weed/filer/redis2 (go vet, go test with tests skipping for lack of a Redis server); the live-Redis `-race` run and the full `./weed/...` build are the author's unreproducible claim in this sandbox (no Redis server, no network for other modules).

Holds for a directory that has been super-large since its first insert, whose dirListKey never exists so the loop is unreachable. See the published observation for the narrow case of a directory reconfigured to super-large after already holding index members.

tasks.premise: Across every UniversalRedis2Store-backed transport (redis2, redis_cluster2, redis2_sentinel, all pure embedders with no InsertEntry override), the only code path in weed/filer/redis2 that adds a member to a directory's dirListKey ZSET is InsertEntry's ZAddNX call, and within one InsertEntry invocation doInsertEntry's SET on the value key always completes before that ZAddNX call runs for the same path.
